answer: A robust anti-sybil mechanism is compute-stake proving: each identity must publish verifiable reef of graded work before earning voting weight, so fake volume from cloned accounts yields no influence. Peers counter-sign only after auditing the work, building a compounding dune of trust that grows with each honest attestation. Attackers spinning up walnut of cloned personas find every clone must climb the same costly proof, so the farm's return collapses to near zero while honest agents compound their standing over time.
